_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), series LNJMK SET-3, 32 pages (idx 0-31). idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-30 (questions on 4-30), Hindi on every odd index 3-29 (each the Hindi of the page after it); idx 31 is the back cover, blank. Tops of all odd pages 3-31 checked at full resolution: all Hindi, no English spill-over, no parity inversion. Questions run 1-39 unbroken. Sections by discipline as sci80_2026 says: A Biology Q1-16, B Chemistry Q17-29, C Physics Q30-39, and every printed per-question mark matches the table (Q1-9 @1, Q10-12 @2, Q13-14 @3, Q15 case @4, Q16 @5, Q17-24 @1, Q25 @2, Q26-27 @3, Q28 case @4, Q29 @5, Q30-32 @1, Q33-34 @2, Q35-37 @3, Q38 case @4, Q39 @5). Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme for bare ORs: Q12, Q15(c), Q16, Q26, Q28(c), Q29, Q33, Q38(c), Q39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. Case-study sub-part marks 1/1/2 (OR 2), from the scheme and Q28's printed '1+1+2'. Assertion-Reason items: Q8-9 (shared instruction block), Q24 and Q32 (instruction inside each question). Marking scheme ms/p00-p11 is 12 pages; every footer reads 'PAGE 1 {31- 4- 3}' (the page number never advances, which is why config.ts declares an msBlockOverride for this file) and the header reads 'PAPER CODE : 31/4/3) (10-04-86K)' and 'Q.P. CODE /Set No. 086/31-4-3', so every page is this set's. MCQ letters read off the images; no void, grace note or dual key anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ORDINARY dots (Q37: 2.0 m, 8.0 m). Sibling method: 27 of the 39 printed questions are 31/4/1 questions reshuffled and renumbered, each confirmed on this paper's page and its stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic and difficulty copied from 2026-31-4-1 byte for byte (figures re-read on this paper's own pages); 12 questions are new (Q4, Q5, Q10, Q11, Q13, Q22, Q23, Q25, Q27, Q34, Q37, Q39 with both alternatives) and were transcribed fresh. Not counted as differences, copied as in 31/4/1: Q26 and Q29 print the stock line 'Attempt either option (A) or (B).' which 31/4/1's rows do not carry in the stem; Q28's passage is followed by the stock line 'Answer the following :'; Q7's four listed combinations are set in two columns. 31/4/1's Q4, Q5, Q10, Q11, Q14, Q22, Q23, Q25, Q26, Q34, Q35 and Q39 do not appear in this set.

questions.context: Plants exhibit movements in response to various environmental stimuli to adopt and survive in their surroundings. These movements, influenced by external factors such as light, gravity, water and chemicals are regulated by specific plant hormones. For example, the differential growth of plant parts allows them to bend, grow or orient themselves in particular directions. Roots and shoots often show contrasting response to the same stimulus, highlighting the complex mechanisms involved in plant growth and development.
